comment: BRUNA'S ATTACK TRIGGER PUTS AN AURA FROM HAND ONTO HER, AND IT COUNTS THIS COMBAT. No mana to cast anything (one drawn Forest): the only route to 25 is Bruna attacking (5) and her gather putting Colossification (+20) onto her from HAND. Three rules ride on it: the put does not TARGET (CR 303.4f), so Lightning Greaves' shroud does not stop it; Colossification ENTERS (CR 603.6a) and its 'tap enchanted creature' taps Bruna, which does not remove an attacker from combat (CR 506.4); and FireAttackGatherAuras runs before the damage loop reads power in both worlds. Fails if any of the three is wrong.
